name: E-Reader
description: TSA rules for e-readers and Kindle devices on planes.

carryOn.reason: E-readers (Kindle, Kobo, Nook) are fully allowed in carry-on baggage. They do not need to be removed separately at security checkpoints.

checkedBag.reason: E-readers are allowed in checked baggage though carry-on is recommended.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring an e-reader on a plane?

travelTips: E-readers are ideal for flights — long battery life and lightweight
No need to remove from bag during TSA screening

faq.question: Can I bring a Kindle on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, Kindles and all e-readers are fully allowed in carry-on bags and can be used during flights.

faq.question: Do I need to take my e-reader out of my bag at security?
faq.answer: No, e-readers do not need to be removed separately from your bag at TSA security screening.
